Someone who brings babies (used jokingly, especially with children)
A strong, energetic young man; often used affectionately
A strong, aggressive man; sometimes implies lack of subtlety or refinement
A silly or naive woman; someone who lacks sophistication
A silly or cowardly person; someone who avoids confrontation
A gullible person, especially one who has been cheated (e.g., by a partner)
Someone who lets criticism or problems slide off easily
A person who changes behavior or opinions to fit in; someone who adapts easily, sometimes insincerely
A strong, hardworking person; often used for someone with great endurance
A graceful, independent, or sly person; often used for women
A spy or someone who secretly undermines others
A large or clumsy woman (can be offensive); sometimes used to describe someone slow or dull
A woman who stays at home and focuses only on household chores; often used stereotypically
A clever, cunning person who often manipulates others or avoids trouble through wit
A mischievous or playful person; sometimes used for someone who imitates others
A shy, quiet person who avoids attention
A big, clumsy, but often good-natured person; sometimes used for someone socially awkward
A foolish or slow-witted person; someone who doesn’t learn from mistakes
Someone who mindlessly repeats what others say, lacking original thought
Can mean a loyal person, but also used negatively to describe someone unpleasant or aggressive
A greedy person who takes advantage of others’ misfortune
A person attracted to shiny things; often used for someone who gossips or is materialistic
A rude, greedy person; someone who behaves inappropriately
A deceitful or treacherous person; someone who betrays others
A lone or dangerous person; can also mean someone predatory or assertive
A fast, but easily frightened person; someone who avoids danger quickly
Someone who fulfills others’ wishes or is overly generous
A treacherous, malicious person; someone who betrays trust
